obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Balance must be non-negative before withdrawal
assumptions.justification: A bank account balance is a non-negative integer by domain invariant; negative balances are not representable in this model

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be non-negative; a negative withdrawal would be a deposit and is not handled here
assumptions.justification: API schema for withdrawal endpoint requires amount to be a non-negative integer
